meta.name: finishing-a-development-branch
meta.description: Use when implementation is complete, all tests pass, and you need to decide how to integrate the work - guides completion of development work by presenting structured options for merge, PR, or cleanup

copy.tagline: 选择分支完成方式：合并、拉请求或清理
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在完成开发分支后不确定如何集成代码
copy.tagline_en: Choose how to finish your branch: merge, pull request, or clean up
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you've finished a development branch and need to decide how to integrate it

howto.what: 当代码实现完成、所有测试通过后，Claude会检测Git环境，然后提供合并、创建PR、保留或丢弃分支等选项，并执行用户选择的操作。
howto.when: 当你完成实现、所有测试通过，需要决定如何整合工作时触发。

say.text: 帮我合并当前分支到 main
say.note: Claude会执行本地合并并清理工作区。

say.text: 创建这个分支的 Pull Request
say.note: Claude会推送分支并创建PR，保留工作区以便迭代。
Claude要求确认后强制删除分支和工作区。

howto.what_en: After implementation is complete and tests pass, Claude detects the Git environment and presents options: merge locally, create PR, keep branch, or discard. It then executes the chosen action and cleans up if necessary.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you finish implementation, all tests pass, and you need to decide how to integrate the work.

say_en.text: Merge the current branch to main
say_en.note: Claude merges locally and cleans up worktree.

say_en.text: Create a Pull Request for this branch
say_en.note: Claude pushes and creates PR, preserving worktree.
Claude asks confirmation then force-deletes branch and worktree.
